title: skurb join today anim
script:
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")


local skyboxes = {
    "rbxassetid://72939907928180",   -- Skybox 1
    "rbxassetid://132523807830529",  -- Skybox 2
    "rbxassetid://132621522898283",  -- Skybox 3
}

local function setSkybox(id)
    local existing = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
    if existing then existing:Destroy() end

    local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
    sky.SkyboxBk = id
    sky.SkyboxDn = id
    sky.SkyboxFt = id
    sky.SkyboxLf = id
    sky.SkyboxRt = id
    sky.SkyboxUp = id
    sky.Parent = Lighting
end


while true do
    for _, id in ipairs(skyboxes) do
        setSkybox(id)
        task.wait(0.25)
    end
end
